why: Analysis 2's hedgehog names publishers and electronic composition as the link between printing and communications, and its decline register flags office-equipment acquisitions, a transformational merger and a sudden full exit from printing, which is closest to the key, though it also recommends relocating headquarters. Analysis 1 is better calibrated (it counts four deals correctly where Analysis 2 says five and calls the electronics head a co-founder) and lists integration overload as its own brutal fact, but its hedgehog pushes printing further outside the concept.
